scope: Fixed-anchor correction of same-scene place and rinse controls
summary: The corrected static anchors improved the early task phases, but dense full-timeline review showed the dish rack moving right with the head camera while the bottle endpoint remained fixed, so the place control was rejected.
evidence: Five full-timeline samples at frames 0, 60, 120, 180, and 239 exposed the rack/endpoint drift.
The deterministic trajectory itself remained fully decoded and state-explicit.
lessons: A target attached to a moving Ego scene needs an image-plane trajectory, not one static pixel anchor.
limitations: No heavyweight generation was launched from the rejected place trajectory.
next_actions: Use a smooth time-varying rack target aligned to the camera pan.
